# QS-CFW-2490-88 Quality specification - connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (1045)

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P1  
Parts: CFW-2490-88

Scope
This document defines the quality requirements and inspection method for connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (CFW-2490-88) manufactured from material grade 1045 at Plant P1. It applies to all production forgings and subsequent heat treatment, machining, and final inspection prior to release.

Requirements table

| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 1045 |
| Hardness (post-process) | The hardness range for connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (CFW-2490-88) is 22-27 HRC |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (CFW-2490-88) is ±0.02 mm |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (CFW-2490-88) is 50.1 kg |
| Visual condition | Free from forging laps, cracks, and harmful scale; acceptable machining marks only |

Inspection method
- Verify part identification matches CFW-2490-88 and traceability to the production batch.
- Confirm material certification corresponds to 1045.
- Measure hardness using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester and report values for the part; accept only when within the specified hardness range for connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (CFW-2490-88) is 22-27 HRC.
- Measure bore diameters with calibrated measuring equipment and confirm tolerance; accept only when the bore diameter tolerance for connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (CFW-2490-88) is ±0.02 mm.
- Weigh the forging and confirm it does not exceed the maximum forging weight for connecting rod CFW-2490-88 (CFW-2490-88) is 50.1 kg.
- Perform visual inspection under appropriate lighting for surface defects.

Nonconformance handling
Parts found outside any listed requirement shall be segregated and tagged. Notify Quality and Manufacturing leads for disposition. Disposition options include rework if root cause is correctable and if rework can restore compliance to the listed requirements, or scrap when compliance cannot be achieved. All nonconformance events shall be recorded in the plant quality system and linked to the part identifier CFW-2490-88.
